description: Replays the fixed-k modified-Yao edge-selection pass on a supplied connected plane graph with per-vertex cone and rotation data.

pinned_sources.title: On Geometric Spanners of Euclidean and Unit Disk Graphs

contract.edge_order: Edges have 0<=u<v<n and are sorted lexicographically by (u,v); edge ID is input order.
contract.dart_order: Dart 2e is u->v and dart 2e+1 is v->u for edge e.
contract.sector_order: k=14 equal-angle sectors numbered counterclockwise from a supplied reference ray; boundary rays are excluded. Each vertex's CCW rotation starts at that reference ray, lists darts by nondecreasing cone ID, and lists darts within each cone counterclockwise.
contract.preconditions: The supplied graph is connected and planar; per-endpoint squared lengths, cone assignments, and rotations are consistent with one intended geometric plane-graph instance. The package checks connectedness, rotation-system planarity, dart ownership, framing, and cone ordering. It does not construct a Delaunay graph or verify that the supplied realization is a Delaunay triangulation.
contract.algorithm: At every vertex choose the shortest incident edge in each occupied cone. For each cyclic maximal run of ell empty cones, if ell>1 choose floor(ell/2) previously unselected incident edges clockwise from the run and ceil(ell/2) counterclockwise. If ell=1, inspect the adjacent clockwise/counterclockwise edges: select the other if either is already selected, otherwise choose the shorter.
contract.determinism: Squared lengths order Euclidean lengths. Equal shortest edges and the single-gap equal-length choice use lowest edge ID. A cyclic maximal empty run starts at c when c is empty and c-1 mod 14 is occupied; runs are processed by increasing start cone. For ell>1, clockwise scans backward from the last dart of the preceding occupied cone, skips selected darts, and selects floor(ell/2) before counterclockwise scans forward from the first dart of the following occupied cone to select ceil(ell/2). Singleton runs inspect those nearest darts. The clockwise side is processed first.
contract.output_encoding: One signed-i64 bitmask; bit e is set exactly when both endpoints selected edge ID e.
contract.scope: The measured kernel is the bounded selection pass only. Delaunay construction, geometry-to-cone classification, distributed message behavior, and the source's stretch-factor theorem are not measured or claimed for arbitrary supplied plane graphs.

output.encoding: mutual-selection edge bitmask in input edge-ID order

workspace.description: Conservative fixed-array and call-local cap for the widest native port: bounded edge and dart records, rotations and cone bucket boundaries, graph traversal, face validation, parser state, and selection flags.
